CustomField.label: Stop after a system error
CustomField.description: When checked, the run stops as soon as a check hits an unexpected system error. It does NOT stop for normal Fail or Skipped results - those let the remaining checks keep running. Leave unchecked so a single system error does not hide the results of the other checks.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked = stop the whole run on an unexpected system error. Does not stop on a normal Fail or Skip. Off by default.
